title: Unit 7 — APA-07: Recovering Forces from Coupled Sensor Readings
description: Use MATLAB to recover three signed force components from coupled sensor readings, verify a known-load case, and interpret rank, residuals, conditioning, and sensitivity. Use the supplied completed solver while writing your own main script from the APA-07 Canvas requirements.
note: All inputs and the completed solver are included. The readings are synthetic; channels 1 and 2 are deliberately similar. Keep 0.200 and 0.201 distinct. Run Tests gives feedback and does not submit to Canvas.
